d: In this video, Firstpost explains Abdul El-Sayed's remarks about growing up as a brown child and how his childhood experiences contrasted with Pete Hegseth’s upbringing. El-Sayed recalled his parents rarely attending his games and the feeling that he was never enough. His comments have sparked a wider debate about brown parenting, immigrant families, parental expectations and childhood privilege. The controversy drew reactions from Nicki Minaj and Elon Musk, bringing the Hegseth vs El-Sayed debate into the political spotlight. Cary Johnston brings you the details on Firstpost America.
